KEY. SRS=FBI Summary Return-A (monthly Return A rolled to a year; it is the only FBI-side lane that can record a literal ZERO months reported). NIB=FBI NIBRS rolled to Part-I equivalents (a NIBRS row exists only if the agency's batch header reports >=1 month). CIUS=the FBI's own published agency table (Table 8 city / Table 9 university / Table 11 state-tribal-other). SPUB=a state UCR program's published table (FL FDLE, NY DCJS, MS TOPS). LPUB=a city's own published table. Year lines: 'YY: LANE total/months_reported/tier' -- 12mo=full year, 0mo=SRS carries the agency but records zero months submitted, 'none'=no row in any lane, NoF7=fewer than 7 offense rows in that lane-year. Offense order everywhere: murder/rape/robbery/agg assault/burglary/larceny/motor vehicle theft. CW=footprint ('statewide_overlap_layer'=mass smeared over the whole state; 'state_nonmunicipal_remainder'=the unincorporated remainder; 'municipal:place:XXXXXXX'=one Census place). FBIpop=population served as the FBI records it, by year (0 means the FBI publishes no population for that ORI -- normal for special-jurisdiction and state agencies; '-' means the ORI has no row at all that year). KNOWN INGESTION ARTIFACTS, stated explicitly so you do not have to infer them:

(2) The CIUS published table carries NO months-reported column. The pipeline assigns months_reported=12, quality tier 'high' and weight 1.0 to every CIUS row by assumption, and CIUS outranks both FBI submission lanes in the source-preference ladder. The same assumption is applied to state publications that carry no period field.

Everything in this packet is what SURVIVED those rules.

DECIDE: this agency-year is published as a COMPLETE full year, but its total collapses against its own history and/or against same-type same-size peers. Published as complete, it gets no partial-year uplift and usually no fill, so the number stands as-is in the national panel. KEY. SRS=FBI Summary Return-A (monthly Return A rolled to a year; it is the only FBI-side lane that can record a literal ZERO months reported). NIB=FBI NIBRS rolled to Part-I equivalents (a NIBRS row exists only if the agency's batch header reports >=1 month). CIUS=the FBI's own published agency table (Table 8 city / Table 9 university / Table 11 state-tribal-other). SPUB=a state UCR program's published table (FL FDLE, NY DCJS, MS TOPS). LPUB=a city's own published table. Year lines: 'YY: LANE total/months_reported/tier' -- 12mo=full year, 0mo=SRS carries the agency but records zero months submitted, 'none'=no row in any lane, NoF7=fewer than 7 offense rows in that lane-year. Offense order everywhere: murder/rape/robbery/agg assault/burglary/larceny/motor vehicle theft. CW=footprint ('statewide_overlap_layer'=mass smeared over the whole state; 'state_nonmunicipal_remainder'=the unincorporated remainder; 'municipal:place:XXXXXXX'=one Census place). FBIpop=population served as the FBI records it, by year (0 means the FBI publishes no population for that ORI -- normal for special-jurisdiction and state agencies; '-' means the ORI has no row at all that year). EST2024=the pipeline's current output for 2024: 'observed' means the reported value is kept, hist_median / trend_log_linear / peer_* are FABRICATED from the agency's own past or from peers, true_partial_month_ratio is the reported value scaled by 12/months.

KNOWN INGESTION ARTIFACTS, stated explicitly so you do not have to infer them:
(1) A blank cell in the FBI CIUS published table is DROPPED at parse time, not read as zero. So a CIUS count of 0 in the panel is a LITERAL PRINTED ZERO in the FBI's published table, and a CIUS lane-year showing all 7 offenses is a table row where all seven cells were printed.
(2) The CIUS published table carries NO months-reported column. The pipeline assigns months_reported=12, quality tier 'high' and weight 1.0 to every CIUS row by assumption, and CIUS outranks both FBI submission lanes in the source-preference ladder. The same assumption is applied to state publications that carry no period field.
(3) State-publication all-zero agency-years that ALSO show zero SRS months are already dropped as non-reports by the pipeline (_drop_state_publication_non_reports). Any SPUB zero you see here SURVIVED that rule, i.e. the FBI lane shows a positive months count for the same agency-year.
(4) 2026-07-29 rule batch already landed: cross-lane twins with IDENTICAL 7-offense vectors under one ORI7 were merged (173 variants); dead ORIs whose weight-1.0 footprint is covered by a live ORI are superseded and never filled; NIBRS completion is now keyed on the batch header; NIBRS partial years are annualized like SRS; own-history fills require a real report within 2 years; source lane is now chosen per AGENCY-YEAR, not per offense. Everything in this packet is what SURVIVED those rules.

DECIDE: this agency-year is published as a COMPLETE full year, but its total collapses against its own history and/or against same-type same-size peers. Published as complete, it gets no partial-year uplift and usually no fill, so the number stands as-is in the national panel. Verdicts: credible_low_crime / token_report_treat_as_partial (say how many months are believable) / structural_zero_treat_as_missing / data_error. A rate floor alone cannot tell a genuinely low-crime 800-person village from a token filer — that is why this is here rather than in a rule.
